items.description: Painting the disturbed wall area and closing the wall opening
items.rationale: Opening the wall to reach the leak and making it good afterwards is a repair cost under 7.1.7(a). Priced at a customary small patch-and-paint rate.
First travel charge on invoice 2026-0010, so indemnified under 7.1.7(f). Full rate of about 80.
Consumable installation material is covered under 7.1.7(c). Small amount.
Replacement pipe section for the failed cold-water line, covered under 7.1.7(c). Installed rate for 1 m.
Insulation that formed part of the component as installed, covered under 7.1.7(c). About 18 per unit, as in case 18.
Labour of the trade engaged is covered under 7.1.7(g). One hour at a customary installer rate.
The contractor's own diagnostic and measuring devices are not a repair cost under 7.1.8(b).
Labour covered under 7.1.7(g). Price prior gives about 47 per hour, so 9 hrs x 47 = about 425.
Second travel charge on the same invoice. Under 7.1.7(f) only the first charge is indemnified, so t = 0.
Drying before closing the wall is covered under 7.1.7(b), and the equipment flat rate once per drying operation under 7.1.7(e).
The contractor's own blades are excluded under 7.1.8(b).
Fittings used to connect the repaired section are covered under 7.1.7(c). Two pieces at about 25 each.
This appears to repeat line 4, so it is likely a duplicate under 7.1.8(c) or material exceeding the documented repair under 7.1.8(d).
Second insulation item for the same short repaired section, likely a duplicate of line 5 under 7.1.8(c)/(d).
This appears to duplicate line 8, so it is likely not indemnified under 7.1.8(c) and the 7.1.7(g) time limit. If paid, 9 x 47 = about 425.
